facts.raw_span: 2-year history of gradual-onset right facial weakness leading to paralysis
denied hearing loss, tinnitus, imbalance, or other cranial nerve deficits
complete right facial paralysis
nonpulsatile mass protruding through the inferior ear canal
mild sensorineural loss at 4000 Hz

heterogeneous enhancement on T1 with contrast
expansion of the fallopian canal distal to the second genu of the facial nerve
erosion of the posterior external auditory canal
expansion of the stylomastoid foramen
Pleomorphic hyperchromatic nuclei, staining positive for S100 and negative for KI-67
Low cellularity and low MIB-1 proliferation index

support_spans: nonpulsatile mass protruding through the inferior ear canal
5 × 10-mm irregular lesion in the right mastoid near the stylomastoid foramen
Pleomorphic hyperchromatic nuclei, staining positive for S100 and negative for KI-67
concepts.why: The presence of a nonpulsatile mass and a lesion in the mastoid with heterogeneous enhancement, along with the histological findings of pleomorphic hyperchromatic nuclei and positive S100 staining, are unusual findings that point towards Chondrosarcoma.

support_spans: complete right facial paralysis
expansion of the fallopian canal distal to the second genu of the facial nerve
expansion of the stylomastoid foramen
contradict_spans: Pleomorphic hyperchromatic nuclei, staining positive for S100 and negative for KI-67
concepts.why: The presence of facial paralysis and expansion of the fallopian canal and stylomastoid foramen are findings that could be consistent with a facial nerve schwannoma, but the histological findings are not typical for this diagnosis.

support_spans: Pleomorphic hyperchromatic nuclei, staining positive for S100 and negative for KI-67
Low cellularity and low MIB-1 proliferation index
concepts.why: The histological findings of pleomorphic hyperchromatic nuclei and low cellularity are consistent with myxoid chondrosarcoma, a subtype of chondrosarcoma.

support_spans: nonpulsatile mass protruding through the inferior ear canal
erosion of the posterior external auditory canal
concepts.why: The presence of a nonpulsatile mass in the ear and erosion of the posterior external auditory canal are findings that could be consistent with a cartilaginous tumor of the ear.

support_spans: 5 × 10-mm irregular lesion in the right mastoid near the stylomastoid foramen
expansion of the stylomastoid foramen
concepts.why: The presence of a lesion in the mastoid and expansion of the stylomastoid foramen are findings that could be consistent with a mastoid tumor.
It explains the heterogeneous enhancement on T1 with contrast seen in the MRI scan.
